## Slaplock

Lock any app behind the stock **Face ID / Touch ID** prompt (with passcode fallback). Choose which apps to protect — everything is **off by default**, so nothing is locked until you enable it.

Configure the app list in Settings → Slaplock.

**A12 and newer: supported and confirmed.** Earlier builds put A12+ devices (iPhone XS / XR and later) into safe mode; the current builds are made with Xcode's toolchain and are tested on a real A12+ device.

- Tested on an **iPhone SE (2nd gen, A13)** with iOS 17.5.1 (arm64e) and an **iPhone 8 Plus (A11)** with iOS 16.7, both with Dopamine. On iOS 17 a locked app asks for Touch ID / the passcode and opens after it.
- **If it ever puts you into safe mode:** open Sileo (safe mode still allows it), uninstall it and please [report back](https://github.com/Jond-ie/repo/issues).

- Locked apps re-prompt on next foreground; the app-switcher snapshot is redacted.
- Requires **AltList** (com.opa334.altlist) for the app picker, plus PreferenceLoader; hooks run via ellekit/Substrate.
- Report any bypass you find — that's the most useful feedback.
- Tested on an **iPhone 8 Plus (A11, arm64)** with iOS 16.7. A12 and newer: see Device Support.
